threshold: RR ≥20/min OR PaCO2 ≤32 mmHg OR mechanical ventilation

sources.result: The stated threshold of more than 20 breaths/min supports the RR branch under this specific definition.
An adult described as tachypneic had an explicit rate of 18/min. This challenges the automatic inference from unqualified narrative words. This is an unrelated individual.
An older adult was described as mildly tachypneic at 18/min. External rates do not establish a rate in the TrialGPT patient.
In this immunization reporting context the threshold for people older than 12 is over 16/min. The benchmark emergency case supplies no such reporting context.

sources.result: Tachypnea appears among SIRS general variables without a numeric definition for that wording. The shock column describes hypotension after fluids. This document does not equate the chart adjective to the RR ≥20/min branch in the frozen registry.
